thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error rate detected for external tool/function invocations on hosted inference (prod us-west-2). Auto-created thread for on-call coordination.

mari: seeing 5xxs from tool-proxy, errors spiked around 03:14 UTC — ~3k rps. paging @alex oncall — can you take?

alex: on it. pulling logs now. Initial read: tool-proxy OOM-ish patterns plus repeated large structured-output payloads causing backpressure.

mari: we should live-mitigate — put emergency rate limits on the /v1/generate endpoints that trigger tool calls and reduce structured-output mode for public tier.

alex: agree. I'm toggling the control-plane flag to disable external tool invocation for hosted customers as a broad stopgap. Doing admin API call now.

alex: ```bash
# temporary: disable external tool invocation for hosted tier
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/flags" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"flag":"disable_external_tool_invocation","value":true,"scope":"hosted"}'
```

incident-bot: Flag update accepted (change-id: flag-5732). Rolling config to 3 proxy replicas; expected rollout ~30s.

mari: applying ingress proxy rate-limit: token_rate_limit=50rpm per key for endpoints that can trigger external calls. Patch applied to proxy-config via kubectl.

mari: ```yaml
# proxy patch (applied)
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  tool_call_rate_limit: "50" # rpm per API key
```

ops-sig: noting customer impact: enterprise customers using direct tool integrations will see those invocations rejected (503) during mitigation. Structured JSON responses may be downgraded to plain text or compact mode. Please prepare status page blurb.

alex: drafting status page entry: "We are temporarily restricting external tool/function invocation and strict structured JSON responses on the hosted API to mitigate increased error rates. Model text generation will continue; external integrations may be affected. We will update as we make progress."

sam: I can take a handoff in ~30m. Alex — can you post a short summary of actions taken + rollback plan before handoff?

alex: summary:
- Action: disable_external_tool_invocation flag enabled for hosted (flag-5732)
- Action: ingress rate-limit 50 rpm per API key for tool-call endpoints
- Action: downgraded structured_output_mode to "compact" for public tier streaming
- Observed: error rate on tool-proxy dropped from ~12% -> ~1.2% within 3m of changes
- Whitelist: added allowlist for enterprise keys (cust-901, cust-340) to avoid breaking critical partners
Rollback plan: flip flag to false, remove rate-limit, revert structured_output_mode, do gradual ramp and monitor for regression. Coordinate with infra to avoid thundering herd.

pg-team: adding note — watch p50/p95 latency during ramp, proxy CPU jumped when we hit the error burst so we may need a slower ramp to avoid OOMs.

mari: I put a brief Ops channel update and flagged affected customers via the CRM list. Ops will send an email to the top 10 customers on the allowlist if needed.

incident-bot: Pager handoff scheduled: alex -> sam at 12:30 UTC (automatic reminder queued).

sam: taking over. I'll monitor for 2 hours and coordinate with infra to slowly re-enable tool invocation once error rate <1% for steady 15m. If we see CPU/oome signals during ramp, we'll pause and re-evaluate.

mari: thanks — I'll stay available for partner comms. Please escalate to SRE if proxy memory climbs above 80% during the ramp.

alex: closing out from my side — alerting dev teams to run a focused postmortem if we end up leaving these mitigations for >4h. :thumbsup:

sam: acknowledged. re-open thread if any regression or customer reports.
